verses.en: And it came to pass at the end of two full years, that Pharaoh dreamed: and, behold, he stood by the river.
verses.sm: UA mavae tausaga e lua, ona fai ai lea o le miti a Farao ; faauta foi, ua tu ia i le auvai o le vaitafe.

verses.en: And, behold, there came up out of the river seven well favoured kine and fatfleshed; and they fed in a meadow.
verses.sm: Faauta foi, ua.o ae i le vaitafe povi e fitu tino lelei ma le pepeti, ua latou aai foi ,le vaofalL Faauta foi,

verses.en: And, behold, seven other kine came up after them out of the river, ill favoured and leanfleshed; and stood by the other kine upon the brink of the river.
verses.sm: o isi povi e fitu ua tino leaga ma le paeee ua mulimuli ona o ae ia te i latou i le vaitafe, ua latou tutū i tafatafa o isi povi i le auvai o le vaitafe.

verses.en: And the ill favoured and leanfleshed kine did eat up the seven well favoured and fat kine. So Pharaoh awoke.
verses.sm: Ua aai foi e povi tino leaga ma le paeee i povi e fitu ua tino lelei ma le pepeti. Ona ala mai lea o Farao.

verses.en: And he slept and dreamed the second time: and, behold, seven ears of corn came up upon one stalk, rank and good.
verses.sm: Ua toe moe foi o ia, ona fai ai lea o le isi ana miti; faauta foi, o ‘au saito e fitu ua tutupu mai i le ‘au e tasi, ua soona puputa ma le tino lelei mai.

verses.en: And, behold, seven thin ears and blasted with the east wind sprung up after them.
verses.sm: Faauta, ua muliai tutupu ia te i latou o ‘au saito e fitu e tino leaga ma le mamae i le matagi mai sasae.

verses.en: And the seven thin ears devoured the seven rank and full ears. And Pharaoh awoke, and, behold, it was a dream.
verses.sm: Ua ‘aina foi e ‘au saito tino leaga o ‘au saito e fitu e tino lelei male matutua. Ona ala mai ai lea o Farao ; faauta, o le miti lava.

verses.en: And it came to pass in the morning that his spirit was troubled; and he sent and called for all the magicians of Egypt, and all the wise men thereof: and Pharaoh told them his dream; but there was none that could interpret them unto Pharaoh.
verses.sm: Ua oo i le taeao, ona atuatuvale ai lea o lona loto, ona amiami ai lea i taulāitu uma o Aikupito, atoa ma tagata popoto uma na i ai. Ona tala atu ai lea e Farao o lana miti ia te i latou ; a e leai se na te faamatalaina mai ia Farao.

verses.en: Then spake the chief butler unto Pharaoh, saying, I do remember my faults this day:
verses.sm: Ona fai mai ai lea o le ua sili i e tautu uaina ia Farao, ua faapea mai, Ou te manatua i le aso nei lo‘u sese.

verses.en: Pharaoh was wroth with his servants, and put me in ward in the captain of the guard's house, both me and the chief baker:
verses.sm: Na toasa mai Farao i ana auauna, ua tuu atu ai ia te au ia leoleoina i le fale o le alii e pule i le ‘au e faafeao, o a‘u nei atoa ma le ua sili i e fai mea e ‘ai.

verses.en: And we dreamed a dream in one night, I and he; we dreamed each man according to the interpretation of his dream.
verses.sm: Ona fai ai lea o a ma miti i le po e tasi, o a‘u lava ma ia, ua taitasi ma fai lana miti e tusa ma le faamatalaga.

verses.en: And there was there with us a young man, an Hebrew, servant to the captain of the guard; and we told him, and he interpreted to us our dreams; to each man according to his dream he did interpret.
verses.sm: Na matou i ai foi ma le tasi taulealea, o le Eperu, o le auauna a le alii e pule i le ‘au e.faafeao, na ma tala atu ia te ia, ona faamatala mai ai lea e ia ia te i maua o a ma miti, o le tagata ma lana miti na ia faamatala mai.

verses.en: And it came to pass, as he interpreted to us, so it was; me he restored unto mine office, and him he hanged.
verses.sm: Na taunuu lava faapei ona ia faamatala mai ia te i maua ; na na faafoi ia te au i lo‘u faiva, a ua na faatautau ia te ia.

verses.en: Then Pharaoh sent and called Joseph, and they brought him hastily out of the dungeon: and he shaved himself, and changed his raiment, and came in unto Pharaoh.
verses.sm: Ona feau atu lea e Farao, ua aami ia Iosefa, ua faavaevave foi ona latou au mai ia te ia ai le lua, ua na tafi i lana ‘ava, ma sui ona ofu, ona alu atu ai lea ia Farao.

verses.en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, I have dreamed a dream, and there is none that can interpret it: and I have heard say of thee, that thou canst understand a dream to interpret it.
verses.sm: Ona fai mai ai lea o Farao ia Iosefa, Ua fai la‘u miti, a e leai se na te faamatalaina mai ia te au; ua ou faalogo foi i le tala ia te oe, pe a e faalogo i se miti e te iloa ona faamatalaina.

verses.en: And Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, It is not in me: God shall give Pharaoh an answer of peace.
verses.sm: Ona tali atu ai lea o losefa.ia Farao, ua faapea atu, E le o a‘u, a o le Atua na te avatu se tali lelei ia Farao.

verses.en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, In my dream, behold, I stood upon the bank of the river:
verses.sm: Ona tala mai ai lea e Farao ia Iosefa, Faauta, o ia‘u miti na a‘u tu ai i le auvai o le vaitafe.

verses.en: And, behold, there came up out of the river seven kine, fatfleshed and well favoured; and they fed in a meadow:
verses.sm: Faauta foi, na o ae i le vaitafe o povi e fitu e tino lelei ma le pepeti, na latou aai i le vaofali.

verses.en: And, behold, seven other kine came up after them, poor and very ill favoured and leanfleshed, such as I never saw in all the land of Egypt for badness:
verses.sm: Faauta foi, e mulimuli ia te i latou ona o ae o isi povi e fitu e matuā tino leaga iava ma le paeee, ou te le ik>a lava ni e faapea ona leaga i le nuu uma o Aikupito;

verses.en: And the lean and the ill favoured kine did eat up the first seven fat kine:
verses.sm: na ‘aina foi e povi tino leaga ma le paeee- o povi pepeti e fitu na muamua.

verses.en: And when they had eaten them up, it could not be known that they had eaten them; but they were still ill favoured, as at the beginning. So I awoke.
verses.sm: Ua oo i o latou manava, a e le iloa iava po ua oo i o latou manava, a e peitai ua tino leaga pea faapei o anamua. Ona ou ala ai lea.

verses.en: And I saw in my dream, and, behold, seven ears came up in one stalk, full and good:
verses.sm: Faauta foi, na ou iloa i la‘u miti na fua mai o ‘au saito e fitu i le ‘au e tasi, e soona puputa ma le tino lelei mai.

verses.en: And, behold, seven ears, withered, thin, and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them:
verses.sm: Faauta, na mulimuli ona tutupu mai ia te i latou o isi ‘au saito e fitu e laiti, e tino leaga, ma le mamae i le matagi mai sasae.

verses.en: And the thin ears devoured the seven good ears: and I told this unto the magicians; but there was none that could declare it to me.
verses.sm: Ona folo ai lea e ‘au saito tino leaga o ‘au saito lelei e fitu. Na ou talaina atu foi i le au taulāitu, a e leai se na te mafaia ona faamatalaina mai ia te au.

verses.en: And Joseph said unto Pharaoh, The dream of Pharaoh is one: God hath shewed Pharaoh what he is about to do.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu ai lea o losefa ia Farao, E tau faatasi faalepo a Farao ; ua faaali atu ai e le Atua ia Farao o le mea o le a na faia.

verses.en: The seven good kine are seven years; and the seven good ears are seven years: the dream is one.
verses.sm: O povi lelei e fitu, o tausaga ia e fitu, o ‘au saito lelei e fitu, o tausaga foi ia e fitu; e tasi lava le faalepo.

verses.en: And the seven thin and ill favoured kine that came up after them are seven years; and the seven empty ears blasted with the east wind shall be seven years of famine.
verses.sm: O povi foi e fitu e paeee ma le tino leaga na mulimuli ona o ae ia te i latou, o tausaga ia e fitu ; o ‘au saito foi e fitu e leaga ma le mamae i le matagi mai sasae, o tausaga oge ia e fitu.

verses.en: This is the thing which I have spoken unto Pharaoh: What God is about to do he sheweth unto Pharaoh.
verses.sm: O le upu lava lea ua ou fai atu ai ia Farao, ua faaali atu e le Atua ia Farao o le mea o le a na faia.

verses.en: Behold, there come seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt:
verses.sm: Faauta, o le a oo mai tausaga e fitu e matuā tele ai le mau i le nuu uma o Aikupito.

verses.en: And there shall arise after them seven years of famine; and all the plenty shall be forgotten in the land of Egypt; and the famine shall consume the land;
verses.sm: Ona muliai oo mai ai lea o tausaga oge e fitu, e galo ai le mau uma lava i le nuu o Aikupito ; e faaumatia ai le nuu i le oge.

verses.en: And the plenty shall not be known in the land by reason of that famine following; for it shall be very grievous.
verses.sm: E le toe iloa foi le mau i le nuu ona o le oge e mulimuli i ai; auā e velavela lava ia.

verses.en: And for that the dream was doubled unto Pharaoh twice; it is because the thing is established by God, and God will shortly bring it to pass.
verses.sm: Na foi faalua mai le faalepo ia Earao ; auā o le mea ua matuā faamauina e le Atua, e vave foi ona faataunuu mai e le Atua.

verses.en: Now therefore let Pharaoh look out a man discreet and wise, and set him over the land of Egypt.
verses.sm: O lenei, ia saili e Farao se tagata mafaufau ma le poto, ma ia tofia o ia e pule i le nuu o Aikupito.

verses.en: Let Pharaoh do this, and let him appoint officers over the land, and take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt in the seven plenteous years.
verses.sm: Ia fai lea mea e Farao, ia tofia foi matai i le nuu, ma ia avae lona lima o fua o le fanua o Aikupito i tausaga mau E fitu.

verses.en: And let them gather all the food of those good years that come, and lay up corn under the hand of Pharaoh, and let them keep food in the cities.
verses.sm: ia tofia foi matai i le nuu, ma ia avae lona lima o fua o le fanua o Aikupito i tausaga mau e fitu. la latou £5 faaputu foi i le mea e ‘ai uma i ia tausaga lelei o ]e a oo mai, ma ia tuu āi saito i le pule a Farao, ma ia latou teua mea e ‘ai i aai.

verses.en: And that food shall be for store to the land against the seven years of famine, which shall be in the land of Egypt; that the land perish not through the famine.
verses.sm: E fr.i foi lea mea e ‘ai ma mea e teu mā le nuu i tausaga e fitu o le oge e i ai i le nuu o Aikupito, ina ia le fano le nuu i le oge.

verses.en: And the thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of all his servants.
verses.sm: Ua lelei foi lea upu i le manatu o Farao ma le manatu o ana a.uauna uma.

verses.en: And Pharaoh said unto his servants, Can we find such a one as this is, a man in whom the Spirit of God is?
verses.sm: Ona fai ane ai lea o Farao i ana auauna, Pe tatou te maua ea se tusa ma lenei tagata, o le ua i ai le

verses.en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Forasmuch as God hath shewed thee all this, there is none so discreet and wise as thou art:
verses.sm: Agaga o le Atuar* Ona fai mai ai lea o Farao ia Iosefa, Ua faaali atu e le Atua lea mea uma ia te oe; o le mea lea e leai ai se tusa ma oe i le mafaufau ma le poto.

verses.en: Thou shalt be over my house, and according unto thy word shall all my people be ruled: only in the throne will I be greater than thou.
verses.sm: E te pule oe i lo‘u aiga, o lau lava upu foi e pulea ai lo‘u nuu nma, na o le nofoālii ou te sili ai ia te oe.

verses.en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, See, I have set thee over all the land of Egypt.
verses.sm: Ona fai mai ai lea o Farao ia Iosefa, Faauta mai, ua ou tuu atu ia te oe le pule i le nuu uma o Aikupito.

verses.en: And Pharaoh took off his ring from his hand, and put it upon Joseph's hand, and arrayed him in vestures of fine linen, and put a gold chain about his neck;
verses.sm: Ona to ese ai lea e Farao lana mama i lona lima, ua tuu mai i le lima o Iosefa, ua na faaofu foi ia te ia i ofu ie vavae, ua faaasoa foi ]e filifili auro i lona ua;

verses.en: And he made him to ride in the second chariot which he had; and they cried before him, Bow the knee: and he made him ruler over all the land of Egypt.
verses.sm: ua na faatietie foi ia te ia i le lua o ona nofoa faataava.levale, ona latou alalaga lea i ona luma, Ifo ia. Ua na tuu atu foi ia te ia le pule i le nuu uma o Aikupito.

verses.en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, I am Pharaoh, and without thee shall no man lift up his hand or foot in all the land of Egypt.
verses.sm: Ua fai mai foi Farao ia losefa, O a‘u o Farao, e le sii e se tasi lona lima po o lona vae e aunoa ma oe i le nuu uma o Aikupito.

verses.en: And Pharaoh called Joseph's name Zaphnath-paaneah; and he gave him to wife Asenath the daughter of Poti-pherah priest of On. And Joseph went out over all the land of Egypt.
verses.sm: Ua faaigoa foi e Farao ia Iosefa o Sapenapaenea; ua avane foi ia te ia o Asenati e fai rnana avā, o le afafine ia o Potifere le ositaulaga i Onu; ona alu atu ai lea o Iosefa i le nuu uwa o Aikupito.

verses.en: And Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt. And Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh, and went throughout all the land of Egypt.
verses.sm: O le tolugafulu foi o ona tausaga na tu ai Iosefa i luma o Farao le tupu o Aikupito. Ona alu atu ai lea o Iosefa nai luma o Farao, ua ui ane i le nuu uma o Aikupito.

verses.en: And in the seven plenteous years the earth brought forth by handfuls.
verses.sm: Ua pesi tele mai le fua o le fanua i tausaga mau e fitu.

verses.en: And he gathered up all the food of the seven years, which were in the land of Egypt, and laid up the food in the cities: the food of the field, which was round about every city, laid he up in the same.
verses.sm: Ona ia faaputuina ai lea o mea e ‘ai uma i tausaga e fitu na i ai i le nuu o Aikupito, ua na tuuina atu le mea e ‘ai i aai; o le mea e ‘ai o le fanua na vagavagaia le aai na ia tuuina atu i totonu o lea lava aai.

verses.en: And Joseph gathered corn as the sand of the sea, very much, until he left numbering; for it was without number.
verses.sm: E tele lava saito na faaputuina e Iosefa pei o le oneone i le sami, ua iu ina tuua o le faitau, auā ua le masino lava.

verses.en: And unto Joseph were born two sons before the years of famine came, which Asenath the daughter of Poti-pherah priest of On bare unto him.
verses.sm: Na fanaua foi e Iosefa ona atalii e toalua a o lei oo mai tausaga oge, na fanau ai ia te ia e Asenati le afafine o Potifere le ositaulaga i Ouu.

verses.en: And Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh: For God, said he, hath made me forget all my toil, and all my father's house.
verses.sm: Ua faaigoa e Iosefa lana ulumatua o Manase, auā ua faapea ane ia, Ua faia e le Atua ina ia galo ia te au lo‘u tiga uma atoa ma le aiga uma o lo‘u tamā.

verses.en: And the name of the second called he Ephraim: For God hath caused me to be fruitful in the land of my affliction.
verses.sm: Ua ia faaigoa foi i le aupito ane i ai, o Efaraima, ua faapea ane ia, Auā ua faauluolaina a‘u e le Atua i le nuu na puapuagatia ai a4u.

verses.en: And the seven years of plenteousness, that was in the land of Egypt, were ended.
verses.sm: Ua mavae foi le fitu o tausaga mau na i le nuu o Aikupito.

verses.en: And the seven years of dearth began to come, according as Joseph had said: and the dearth was in all lands; but in all the land of Egypt there was bread.
verses.sm: Ona amata ai lea ona oo mai o tausaga e fitu o le oge, faapei ona fai atu ai o Iosefa; ua i ai foi le oge i nuu uma, a o le nuu uma o Aikupito sa i ai mea e ‘ai.

verses.en: And when all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried to Pharaoh for bread: and Pharaoh said unto all the Egyptians, Go unto Joseph; what he saith to you, do.
verses.sm: Ua mātelaina le nuu uma o Aikupito, ona alalaga mai ai lea o le nuu ia Farao i le mea e ‘ai; ona fai atu ai lea o Farao i tagata uma o Aikupito, Ia outou o atu ia Iosefa; o le mea e fai atu ai o ia ia te outou, ia outou faia.

verses.en: And the famine was over all the face of the earth: And Joseph opened all the storehouses, and sold unto the Egyptians; and the famine waxed sore in the land of Egypt.
verses.sm: Ua i ai foi le oge i le nuu uma, ona talai ai lea e Iosefa o mea uma na faaputuina ai saito, ma na faatau at i i tagata Aikupito; sa velavela foi le oge i le nuu o Aikupito.

verses.en: And all countries came into Egypt to Joseph for to buy corn; because that the famine was so sore in all lands.
verses.sm: Ua o mai foi nuu uma i Aikupito e faatau saito ia Iosefa; auā sa velavela le oge i nuu uma lava. O le tala i le malaga a atalii o
